posts.title: Excellent CMS 1.0
posts.summary: The first release: from spreadsheet to API in minutes.
posts.body:
Excellent CMS turns spreadsheets into a typed database, an admin app and a REST API. This first release brings the import, permissions per entity, OAuth clients, a rate limit and the media library.

Read the [getting started guide]({{url}}/docs/getting-started).

seo.description: The first release: from spreadsheet to API in minutes.

posts.title: Projects and languages
posts.summary: Several projects in one installation, and translatable fields.
posts.body: One installation can now hold several projects, each with its own content API under `{{api_url}}/<project>/content`. Fields can be translatable, and `?lang=` picks the language.

seo.description: Several projects in one installation, and translatable fields.

posts.title: Field groups
posts.summary: Reuse sets of fields across entities.
posts.body: Field groups bundle fields like SEO keywords and description for reuse in pages, blog posts and anything else. Groups can be nested, repeatable and translatable - and existing fields can be turned into a group.

seo.description: Reuse sets of fields across entities.
